title: dasiphora fruticosa var. veitchii
intro: Dasiphora fruticosa var. veitchii, commonly known as Tibetan rhododendron or rock rose, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of the Tibetan Plateau. This plant has been traditionally used in Tibetan medicine to treat various ailments, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Dasiphora fruticosa var. veitchii include stimulating the immune system, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
